name: Himitsu no Bridal ~Auction no Hanayome~
original_name: 秘蜜のブライダル ～オークションの花嫁～
source:
You open your eyes to find yourself being sold off on a black market auction, and before you know it you've been sold... for 30 million dollars?? He whisks you away to a luxurious high rise hotel, where you find yourself ensnared in world of celebrity and high-stakes intrigue.

The man who bough you says you've known each other since you were children...
...But you can't even remember your own name! And he's your fiance?!

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.arismile.n48a319]Google Store[/url]]
translation:
你睁开眼睛，发现自己在黑市拍卖会上被出卖，不知不觉间，你已经被卖了……3000万美元？他带你去了一家豪华的高层酒店，在那里你发现自己陷入了名人和高风险阴谋的世界。

买下你的男人说你们从小就认识……
……但是你连自己的名字都不记得了！而且他还是你的未婚夫？！

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.arismile.n48a319]Google商店[/url]]
